_comment: Run this command once you have created a SAP BAPI connection in Integration Service and know your BAPI name.
_command: uip maestro flow node configure VendorInvoiceProcessing.flow postInvoiceToSap1 --detail '<json below>'
connectionId: <REPLACE: paste the connection ID from 'uip is connections list uipath-sap-bapi --all-folders'>
folderKey: <REPLACE: paste the Orchestrator folder key where the connection lives>

bodyParameters.BapiName: <REPLACE: e.g. BAPI_ACC_DOCUMENT_POST for AP invoice posting>
